summary: Iter127 narrow frontend-only check. Every /api/** call was mocked: the iter126 fixture plus a new iter127 wrapper that fixes the visited model. No real DB, auth or AI. ROOT CAUSE of the 126 'visited' failure was the FIXTURE, not the app: useAttempt.visit() sets data.current.visited = r.visited from POST /attempts/:id/visit, and the 126 fixture answered {ok:true}, which wiped visited to undefined. With the corrected fixture, every Player number state renders distinctly and correctly at 1920x800 and 390x844. Not visited: white bg, slate text. Visited-blank: amber #FFF7E9 bg, #905515 text. Answered: sky #F0F9FF bg, #0284C7 text, check icon. Marked: burgundy tint, #6B1B3A border, flag. Answered+marked: burgundy with an inset 3px blue bottom bar. Pending: dashed #905515 border. Current: 2px solid #2156D4 outline with offset 2, aria-current=step. The current ring is present and visible. Solutions: outcome badge is 11px capitalize. Subject tabs are Physics blue, Chemistry green, Mathematics crimson; selected is solid. Subject and question switching update the label and URL. No horizontal overflow on Player or Solutions at either viewport. My Tests: Progress amber, Saved blue, Completed green. Series analytics tab is green. ONE REAL BUG: the active score-version button is NOT solid blue.

ui_bugs.issue: The active/disabled version (aria-pressed=true, disabled) renders light brand-soft bg rgb(237,243,255) with text #214DB7, not solid #2459D8 with white text. Cause: App.css:6145 '.grade-history .btn:disabled' (specificity 0,3,0) beats vibrant-ui.css:129 '.score-version-button[aria-pressed=true]' (0,2,0). Opacity is 1 and aria-pressed/disabled toggle correctly between Original and Key version 2. Fix: raise specificity, e.g. '.grade-history .score-version-button[aria-pressed=true], .grade-history .score-version-button[aria-pressed=true]:disabled {background:#2459D8;border-color:#2459D8;color:#fff;opacity:1}'.

issues: .solution-legend spans compute to 10px at both 1920 and 390. Only the Player .nav-legend is 11px. If the 'nav legend 11px' polish was meant for Solutions too, it is not applied.
The 'For review' legend swatch border is light #D9B8C6, but the real marked button border is dark #6B1B3A. This is a small legend/state mismatch (cosmetic).

action_items: Fix score-version active button specificity so the current version is solid blue #2459D8 with white text (App.css:6145 overrides vibrant-ui.css:129).
Optional: set .solution-legend to 11px if intended, and align the legend-marked swatch border with the real marked state.
critical_code_review_comments: Player grid descendant selectors work with the shadcn Button inside .number-grid. Every state class is applied with the expected computed style. Do not judge 'current' by background: it is an outline-only contract by design.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (1 of 10 targeted checks failed: score-version solid blue)

rca of the issue: Visited state 'missing' in 126 and in main's self-test: the fixture returned {ok:true} for POST /attempts/play1/visit. useAttempt.js:294 assigns r.visited, which made visited undefined, so no 'visited' class. This was a fixture bug, not an app bug. Score-version not solid: a CSS specificity conflict as described above.
